v1.27.11 (21 August 2024) |feed_title = 💎 Fallen Heroes (Part 1)! 💎 |previous_update = [[v1.27.0|Fallen Foes Update]] |next_update = [[v1.28.0|Fallen Heroes Update (Part 2)]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.27.5''' is the eighty-first update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 9th of August 2024. It added the first set of {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} skins and a few [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode balancing changes. This update was also given the name ''Fallen Heroes Update (Part 1)''. This update had nine versions, the main v1.27.5 update (released 9 August 2024), and eight minor updates, the v1.27.5a (released 9 August 2024), v1.27.6 (released 9 August 2024), v1.27.6a (released 9 August 2024), v1.27.7 (released 12 August 2024), v1.27.8 (released 13 Augsut 2024), v1.27.9 (released 15 August 2024), v1.27.10 (released 21 August 2024) and v1.27.11 (released 21 August 2024). ==Additions== ===Maps=== *[[Wrecked Battlefield II]] (Survival & Hardcore) ===Skins=== *Five new skins obtained from [[Mission Quests]]. **[[Brawler]]: {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} **[[Militant]]: {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} **[[Accelerator]]: {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} **[[Mortar]]: {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} **[[Cowboy]]: {{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Fallen Tank]] buffed. **Health increased from 6,000 to 9,000. **Cash gained increased from {{Money|1,980}} to {{Money|2,970}} every 33% health lost. *[[Fallen King]] buffed. **Health increased from 175,000 to 200,000. **Cash gained increased from {{Money|17,500}} to {{Money|20,000}} every 10% health lost. *[[Awakened Fallen King]] buffed. **Health increased from 650,000 to 800,000. **''Army of Chaos'' ability now can summon [[Fallen Shield]]s with a 20% chance. **''Army of Chaos'' ability now summons [[Fallen Giant]]s and [[Fallen Hero]]es with a 40% chance instead of 15%. **''Army of Chaos'' can no longer summon [[Corrupted Fallen]]s and [[Possessed Armor]]s. *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode changed. **Wave structure changed. **Wave bonus formula changed, increasing rewards by {{Coins|100}}. **Triumph bonus decreased from {{Coins|150}} to {{Coins|100}}. **Updated soundtracks to play on different waves. ***First set of tracks now plays on Waves 1-9, 10-15 and 16-22. ***Second set of tracks now plays on Waves 23-29. ***Third set of tracks now plays on Waves 30-34 and 35-39. **Corrected ''business'' being misspelled as ''buisness'' on Wave 1, updated wording on Wave 1, changed wording on Wave 35, and corrected ''soldier'' being misspelled as ''solider'' alongside a few punctuation corrections on Wave 40. **Updated Wave 35 dialogue slightly. *[[Hidden Wave]] wave structure changed. *Disabled {{ReviveTicket|Revive Tickets}}. *Disabled revives. *{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} [[Scout]] skin rarity changed from {{Color|Exclusive}} to {{Color|Rare}}. *{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} [[Minigunner]] skin rarity changed from {{Color|Exclusive}} to {{Color|Rare}}. *''The Underworld Dreg'' third objective and ''Unyielding Shooter'' first objective now require [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode triumphs instead of [[Fallen King]] kills. *''A Mysterious Drifter'' third objective no longer mentions that [[Badlands II]] has to be triumphed on [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *Fixed [[Bloated]] not working on enemies which had their health altered with modifiers. *Fixed objective descriptions for the ''Unyielding Shooter'' not mentioning [[Minigunner]] being required to be placed down in its third objective. *Fixed the ''PLAY SURVIVAL'' button not appearing for every player. :In '''v1.27.5a''': *Fixed [[Wrecked Battlefield II]] using incorrect ground textures. :In '''v1.27.6''': *Fixed [[Login Rewards]] being stuck on day one. :In '''v1.27.6a''': *[[Awakened Fallen King]] health increased from 800,000 to 1,000,000. *[[Hidden Wave]] wave structure changed. :In '''v1.27.7''': *'''Condemned Vigilante''' second objective requirement reduced from 400,000 damage to 250,000 damage. *Fixed ''Condemned Vigilante'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] third objective being impossible to complete. :In '''v1.27.8''': *Fixed ''Condemned Vigilante'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] third objective not tracking the number of placed [[Cowboy]]s correctly. :In '''v1.27.9''': *[[Deluxe Crate]], [[Premium Crate]], {{SpinTicket|Spin Tickets}}, [[Phantom Crate]] and [[High Grade Crate]] can no longer be purchased by players in Belgium and the Netherlands, and players in the United Kingdom that cannot verify their age to be over 18. :In '''v1.27.10''': *Version number changed from ''v1.27.9'' to ''v1.27.10''. :In '''v1.27.11''': *Version
